_note: IN-11. The one curated list of providers that a member can connect. No secret, ever. Readers: connector_list.py and src/lib/connectors.generated.ts (scripts/gen_connectors.py).

rows.label: Email account
rows.unlocks: Read and send email from your own mailbox.

rows.label: WhatsApp Business
rows.unlocks: Read and send WhatsApp messages from a business number.
rows.key_hint: Find the access token in Meta Business Manager, under WhatsApp accounts.

rows.label: Zoho CRM
rows.unlocks: Sync deals, contacts and accounts with Zoho CRM.

rows.label: GitHub
rows.unlocks: Read repositories, issues and pull requests.

rows.label: Google Calendar
rows.unlocks: Show your Google events in Calendar and send tasks to it.

rows.label: Outlook Calendar
rows.unlocks: Show your Outlook events in Calendar and send tasks to it.

rows.label: Google Drive
rows.unlocks: Read your Drive files into Knowledge.

rows.label: Apollo.io
rows.unlocks: Look up contacts and companies for prospecting.
rows.key_hint: Open Apollo, then Settings, then Integrations, then API Keys.

rows.label: Google Maps
rows.key_hint: Open Google Cloud Console, then APIs and Services, then Credentials.

rows.label: Instantly.ai
rows.unlocks: Send and track cold email campaigns.
rows.key_hint: Open Instantly, then Settings, then Integrations.

rows.label: SerpAPI
rows.unlocks: Run web searches and read the results.
rows.key_hint: Open the SerpAPI dashboard and copy the API key.

rows.label: Apify
rows.key_hint: Open Apify, then Account, then Integrations, and copy the personal API token.

rows.label: AnyMailFinder
rows.key_hint: Open your AnyMailFinder account page and copy the API key.

rows.label: Google Sheets
rows.unlocks: Read and write Google Sheets for export and reports.
rows.key_hint: Make a service account in Google Cloud Console, then share each Sheet with it.

rows.label: SMTP relay
rows.unlocks: Send email through your own mail relay.
rows.key_hint: Ask your mail host for the server name, port, user name and password.

rows.label: Another system
rows.unlocks: Connect a system that has an MCP server. Use an OpenAPI door when it has no MCP server.
rows.key_hint: Ask the system owner for the MCP address. A key may come with it.
